item.title: Proposed bill bans gender changes on Kansas driver’s licenses, birth certificates
item.description: A bill that would ban gender changes on Kansas driver’s licenses and birth certificates drew hundreds of opponent comments despite appearing on a committee agenda just 24 hours before the Tuesday hearing. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence Humane Pet of the Week: Maylene is ‘some pig’
item.description: Charlotte's first message in her famous web, "Some pig," may as well be about 4-year-old Maylene, whose snorting has been described as unbelievably charming. Continue reading ...

item.title: Haskell cultural center’s first student exhibitor says creating is medicine
item.description: Marina DeCora’s solo show, "ReVision," roves through themes of mental and community health, reconnection and attachment to land. It's the first student exhibition at the Haskell Cultural Center and Museum. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence Farmers Market, eyeing downtown parks for new home, answers questions at town hall
item.description: The Lawrence Farmers Market is eyeing two downtown parks for a permanent location, and representatives shared plans and answered community members' questions during a town hall Wednesday. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence Habitat for Humanity to give out free winter weatherization kits
item.description: Lawrence Habitat for Humanity on Saturday will distribute free kits to help folks prep their homes for winter weather. Continue reading ...

item.title: ‘America is showing its dark underbelly’: Protesters condemn ICE in rally at Kansas Statehouse
item.description: Hundreds of Kansans chanted “f*** ICE,” carried pointed and sometimes profane signs, and sang protest songs Wednesday as they flooded the second floor of the Statehouse to rally for human rights. Continue reading ...

item.title: Rec centers to close, trash pickup not delayed and more notes for MLK Jr. Day in Lawrence
item.description: Recreation centers will be closed, parking downtown will be free and trash pickup will run as scheduled. Here are details and more notes ahead of the Martin Luther King Jr. holiday in Lawrence. Continue reading ...

item.title: KU research advances functional fitness to help people with mobility limitations build strength
item.description: KU researchers are partnering with a Lawrence gym to advance functional fitness, helping people with mobility limitations in their day-to-day lives. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence board signs off on markers to honor teens killed by police in 1970
item.description: A city board has finally approved historic markers to pay tribute to Rick "Tiger" Dowdell and Nick Rice, teens who were shot and killed by Lawrence police officers in 1970, though the board wants the shooters named on both markers. Continue reading ...
